notes: Hiding a duplicate song, or all of an album's duplicates, now shows on the album's page at once.
A song you hid as a duplicate comes back by itself when its other copy leaves your library.
Unhide Duplicates, in the album's Duplicates button, brings back the copies you hid.
Support & Updates is now News & Updates. Limpid's own updates are in Settings.
Album pictures and artist photos now have shadows with the same rounded corners, also in Now Playing with the Visualizer on.
